## WF-05: Alarm Correlation & Deduplication Engine

Standalone, reusable sub-workflow. Called by WF-04 (Site Metadata Enrichment) via an 'Execute Workflow' node, passing its enriched alarm output.

Flow:
Execute Workflow Trigger -> Validate Input -> Correlation & Deduplication Engine -> [Duplicate Ignored | Merged - Child Alarm Added | New Master Incident Created]

Uses n8n's built-in workflow static data as the incident store (see README 'Performance Optimization' for production scaling notes).

No Telegram, no Slack, no Email, no dashboard, no ticketing - correlation and deduplication only.

### Business rules implemented
1. Fiber Cut at a site cascades LOS / High BER / other alarms on the same fiber route (or site) into ONE master incident as child alarms.
2. Same Site ID (or fiber route) receiving alarms within a 5-minute sliding window -> merged into the open incident, not a new one.
3. Same Correlation ID seen again -> exact duplicate, ignored (duplicateCount++, no new incident/child).
4. Any new distinct alarm folded in -> occurrenceCount++ (root + all children).

### Error handling & performance
Missing required fields -> Error Output - Invalid Input, never reaches the engine.

The engine node has retry enabled (2 attempts) for transient failures, though as pure in-memory logic it rarely fails.

Storage uses n8n workflow static data (zero external setup). A retention prune runs every execution to bound memory. See README for production scaling (Redis/Postgres) notes and concurrency caveats.
